subject: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot

Team —

Quick note: Acme Bio is asking for a 6-week POC extension and a one-time 200k token credit beyond our standard PLG grant. This is out-of-band vs the standard 30k PLG cap. Why this matters: Acme is a large, regulated prospect in a vertical we want to win (bioinformatics pipelines + enterprise research). They flagged procurement timelines (legal + board signoff) and said their internal vendor review board only meets next week; without the extension they will pause evaluation and push to a competitor.

What I'm asking: executive approval to grant the 6-week extension and approve the 200k free-credit top-up contingent on: (1) signed PO (net-60) acknowledging usage limits, (2) SOC2 evidence shared (we have SOC2 Type II PDF), and (3) product team to lock model/cost caps for the POC.

Economic rationale (short): if this converts, initial ARR is projected at $450k ARR with 18-month expansion runway; expected to cover credits within 4 months post-conversion. Sales willing to accept a short-term revenue deferral for strategic positioning.

Attachments: POC_Terms_v3.pdf (proposed terms), week1 usage report.

Can you review? Need a quick thumbs-up or questions by EOD so I can respond to Acme and coordinate legal.

Thanks —
Tessa
Sr. Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(t) +1 415-555-0109

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot

Appreciate the context, Tessa. A few rapid questions before I escalate to Rishi for signoff:
- Is the 200k token amount the minimum they need to complete their expanded evaluation, or is there room to structure as usage-based tranche (100k now, 100k unlocked on milestone)?
- Any compliance flags other than SOC2? (data residency, patient PHI concerns, encryption at rest)
- Does Legal see any non-standard indemnities in the attached POC_Terms_v3?

If answers are clean, fine to take to Rishi. Also suggest we require a short mutual action plan (MAP) linking the extension to 2 target milestones and a conversion check-in at week 4. Will reduce open-ended risk.

Markus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme-bio.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme BioProcurement <procure@acme-bio.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot

Tessa —

Thanks for the quick note. Confirming the ask from our side: a 6-week add-on and a 200k token credit are ideal. We can split the credit (100k now / 100k on completion of milestone A) if that helps. Our board requires the vendor to commit to SLA and to provide SOC2 Type II (we have that checklist attached). We will issue a PO (net-60) once we have the extension in writing — procurement will circulate this to legal and the board.

One important detail: due to internal data rules, any run that touches patient-derived sequences must be routed to their private VPC. We can limit the POC to de-identified datasets to avoid compliance overhead; would appreciate confirmation what that implies for billing and infra.

Sanjay
Head of Research Platforms, Acme Bio
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot

Thanks — reviewed the attachments quickly. Legal flagged two items in POC_Terms_v3: one non-standard audit right clause and an indemnity paragraph that needs softening. Those are typical and I propose we: (1) accept the 6-week extension, (2) agree to the 200k credit but split into 100k upfront / 100k after milestone A, (3) require the MAP and signed PO, (4) remove the absolute audit clause and replace with "audit upon reasonable cause" language.

On the compliance front: SOC2 Type II is sufficient for initial evaluation; for runs touching patient data we'd require Private deployment or VPC isolation which may change cost. We should capture that in the MAP and make the 100k second tranche conditional on no PHI runs or agreement to private deployment terms.

If everyone agrees, escalate to Rishi for final approval (with the split-credit & MAP guardrails).

Laura
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board approval request: POC extension + complimentary credits for strategic pilot

All —

Have reviewed. Approve the 6-week extension and the 200k token credit under the following executive approvals/conditions:
1) Structure credit as 100k upfront + 100k released on completion of Milestone A (MAP attached to HubSpot deal).
2) Require signed PO (net-60) and updated POC_Terms_v3 with Laura's redlines (audit & indemnity language).
3) No PHI processing on hosted runs; if Acme requires private/VPC runs we will transition to a paid Dedicated engagement and credits will be applied to onboarding fees, not per-token billing.
4) Product: enable a temporary hard cap on model/context size and token throughput for the POC to limit surprise costs. Engineering to confirm within 48 hours.

Tessa — please reply to Acme with the approved structure and copy Legal to start updated terms. Markus — priority handle conversion cadence and ensure MAP is in HubSpot. I'll sign the DocuSign once Legal uploads redlined terms.

Rishi
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
